item.title: New pathways found to reduce fibromyalgia pain and depressive symptoms
item.description: Fibromyalgia is a chronic condition affecting 2% to 6% of the global population, marked by widespread, persistent pain often associated with depression.

item.title: EASD 2026 to highlight new diabetes approaches
item.description: The 2026 meeting of the European Association for the Study of Diabetes will feature new perspectives on first-line treatments for type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

item.title: Gene expression shift may predict pancreatitis severity
item.description: A study of acute pancreatitis patients shows levels of a heat-shock protein gene drop in milder cases, while a related gene variant is a factor.

item.title: Young adults increasingly get memorable health advice from strangers online
item.description: Emily Pfender, an assistant professor of communications at the University of Delaware, is a researcher on a new study in Health Communication.
